title: Create release primer and rapid review station for short-cycle launches
creator: Anika Rao
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable release primer artifact and a 30-minute "rapid review station" process to accelerate stakeholder signoff on customer-facing changelogs and internal launch briefs for short-cycle releases (weekly or biweekly). The primer is a one-page template for each audience (developers, platform customers, support/CS, legal/security) with key changes, rollback signal, risk level, and suggested messaging. The rapid review station is a scheduled, pre-seeded review window (Slack thread + 30-min Zoom) with triage roles: PM owner, technical reviewer, legal reviewer, docs owner, and comms owner.
acceptance_criteria: One-page release primer template completed and stored in Confluence under /LaunchOps/Primers
An automated PR checklist that links the PR to the primer is added to the release-notes repo
Two pilot releases use the primer and rapid review station with signoff recorded
Turnaround time from primer draft to stakeholder signoff reduced to <= 48 hours for pilot
Support and docs have a pre-populated FAQ section in the primer for each release
